inventory.description: Pixels show one upper and one lower wire from the left resistor to separated right-hand binding posts; upper/lower return corners are joined only through the resistor. No source symbol, switch, battery, ground, current arrow, or polarity sign is printed. Wire straightening is a modern schematic regularization, not a measured source dimension.
One vertical outlined rectangular resistor on the left leg, labeled R on its right; no resistance number or unit is present.

Two separated hollow circular posts on the right leg, each with a short southwest-to-northeast oblique stroke. No conductor crosses the gap. Diagram coordinates and gap size are layout choices, not source physical dimensions.

The printed supply annotation is u = U_м cos ωt; the subscript is the amplitude marker, not an RMS marker. The artwork uses Latin subscript m as a visual English/math label alias only. Its equation and meaning are unchanged; this does not authorize any alias in lesson math_signature.

One unruled shared frame: vertical quantity axis at the initial time and horizontal right-directed t axis through zero. Printed labels are i_R near the upper left, u_R above/right of the vertical axis, origin 0 and t near the right end. No ticks, grid, numeric amplitude, period value, time interval, units, or independent second axis.

Two solid curves in the same frame: thin taller u_R(t) and thick shorter i_R(t). Both begin above zero near a positive maximum, fall through the same first zero, have a negative trough at the same horizontal position, pass the same second zero, have another positive maximum together, then cross the same third zero and end on the falling negative branch. The thin voltage curve extends farther right/down than the thick current curve. No phase lag is shown. The drawing height ratio has no given numerical meaning.

Upper-right u_R(t) label is attached by a short solid leader to the thin voltage curve; lower-right i_R(t) label is attached by a short solid leader to the thick current curve. These are label leaders, not additional waveforms or measurement arrows.

voltage.note: Coordinates, smoothing and height ratio are graphical regularization, not inferred volts, amps, time or resistance values.
